title: Garlic Butter Pasta with Parmesan
teaser: A five-ingredient pantry pasta that tastes far fancier than the effort involved.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until just tender, then drain, keeping a mugful of the pasta water.
Melt the butter in the same pot over low heat and add the garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant, not browned.
Tip the pasta back in with a splash of the reserved water and toss well.
Stir in the parmesan until it melts into a light sauce, adding more water if it looks dry.
Season with salt and pepper and scatter parsley over the top.

title: One-Pan Tomato & Basil Pasta
teaser: The pasta cooks straight in the sauce, so there's only one pot to wash.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and soften the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, stock, and pasta, and stir well.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has absorbed (about 12-15 minutes).
Stir in most of the basil and season to taste.
Serve topped with parmesan and the remaining basil.

title: Creamy Chicken & Bacon Pasta
teaser: Chicken, bacon, and a light cream sauce — a firm favourite for a reason.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions.
Meanwhile, fry the bacon in a pan until starting to crisp, then add the chicken and cook until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute.
Pour in the cream, season, and simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Drain the pasta and toss through the sauce with a little parmesan.

title: Sausage & Pepper Pasta
teaser: Sausages, peppers, and a tomato sauce — hearty and simple.
steps: Squeeze the sausage meat out of the skins into small chunks and fry in a little oil until browned.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in the tomatoes and oregano, season, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and serve.

title: Tuna & Sweetcorn Pasta Bake
teaser: A store-cupboard bake that kids and adults both tend to like.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Cook the pasta until just tender, then drain.
Mix the pasta with the tuna, sweetcorn, crème fraîche, and mustard in an ovenproof dish.
Top with the grated cheddar.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

title: Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
teaser: About as fast as dinner gets — jarred pesto, pasta, and fresh tomatoes.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain, keeping a splash of the water.
Return the pasta to the pot off the heat and stir in the pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in the cherry tomatoes and rocket if using.
Serve with parmesan on top.

title: Simple Spaghetti Bolognese
teaser: The classic mince-and-tomato sauce that's always worth having in your back pocket.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned all over.
Stir in the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes, and oregano, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti according to packet instructions and drain.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, or serve the sauce on top, with parmesan.

title: Creamy Salmon & Spinach Pasta
teaser: Pan-fried salmon flaked through a light cream and spinach sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain.
Meanwhile, season the salmon and pan-fry skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and cook for 2-3 minutes more until just cooked through. Flake into large chunks.
In the same pan, soften the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the cream and spinach and simmer until the spinach wilts.
Fold the pasta and flaked salmon through the sauce.
Season to taste and serve with parmesan.
